articles.summary: TULSA, Okla. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 4, 2026-- Williams (NYSE: WMB) today announced its unaudited financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. Natural gas-focused strategy continues to drive key financial results GAAP net income: $864 million, or $0.70 per diluted share (EPS), up 25%
articles.title: Williams Announces Record First-Quarter 2026 Results
